NPK_19_19_19.name: Balanced NPK Fertilizer (19-19-19)
NPK_19_19_19.description: Premium water-soluble nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium formula. Boosts overall plant growth, root architecture, and fruit size.
NPK_19_19_19.benefits: Provides balanced macronutrients, improves flowering, and accelerates vegetative growth.

COPPER_FUNGICIDE.name: Liquid Copper Fungicide
COPPER_FUNGICIDE.description: Organic-approved copper octanoate controls early/late blight, bacterial spot, and leaf mold on vegetable crops.
COPPER_FUNGICIDE.benefits: Halts spore germination, controls bacterial infections, and leaves no toxic soil residue.

NEEM_OIL_SPRAY.name: Cold-Pressed Organic Neem Oil Spray
NEEM_OIL_SPRAY.description: Ready-to-use botanical insecticide, miticide, and fungicide. Ideal for controlling spider mites, whiteflies, and aphids.
NEEM_OIL_SPRAY.benefits: Disrupts pest reproductive cycles, eco-friendly, and safe for beneficial insects like bees.

CALCIUM_NITRATE.name: Calcium Nitrate Foliar Spray
CALCIUM_NITRATE.description: Targeted mineral fertilizer to cure calcium deficiencies. Prevents blossom end rot in tomatoes and pepper fruits.
CALCIUM_NITRATE.benefits: Strengthens cell walls, stops fruit tip rotting, and improves shelf-life.

ORGANIC_COMPOST.name: Bio-Active Vermicompost
ORGANIC_COMPOST.description: Enriched with mycorrhizal fungi and humic acids to restore soil microbiome and boost natural crop immunity.
ORGANIC_COMPOST.benefits: Improves soil moisture retention, provides complete trace minerals, and encourages robust root growth.

MANCOZEB_WP.name: Mancozeb 75% WP Fungicide
MANCOZEB_WP.description: Broad-spectrum contact fungicide that forms a protective layer on leaves to stop fungal blights and Septoria spot.
MANCOZEB_WP.benefits: Multi-site activity prevents resistance build-up, rains-fast, and provides zinc/manganese supplements.

SULFUR_DUST.name: Micronized Sulfur Powder
SULFUR_DUST.description: Dual-action natural dust/spray protecting crops against powdery mildew, leaf molds, and microscopic spider mites.
SULFUR_DUST.benefits: Eco-friendly, acts as both a fungicide and miticide, and provides essential sulfur nutrient.

EPSOM_SALT.name: Pure Agricultural Epsom Salt
EPSOM_SALT.description: Highly soluble magnesium sulfate crystals. Cures leaf yellowing between veins and intensifies green color.
EPSOM_SALT.benefits: Improves chlorophyll synthesis, maximizes fertilizer uptake, and increases crop yields.
